## Phase 2 (Outcome: Working Shell Connection On Bingo/Arcade/International & Vice-Versa)
- [ ] Map all child method combinations for connection types (if a mapping doesn't exist, mark it with ```// TODO: No mapping```)
- [ ] Create monolith shell connection
- [ ] Handle shared game scenario (e.g. bingo|arcade|international built game running in a different shell)
- [ ] Create a basic event bus for non-mapped methods. 9/10 non mapped methods exist because the functionality is baked in the game and not the shell. We can use an event bus to push events to trigger changes needed
- [ ] For all methods marked as ```// TODO: No mapping``` - use event bus to publish events
- [ ] Expose event bus on shell connection

## Phase 3 (Outcome: Working Web Shell UI On Bingo/Arcade/International & Vice-Versa)
- [ ] Build monolithic shell (parent) object. This will be responsible for launching the iframes (web/desktop) and also "connecting" the shell to the game
- [ ] Wrapper Vue component for different shell types. Any components that normally live in games should be copy/pase/modify from existing arcade/bingo/international sources, we're not re-wrtting here, just cherry picking. e.g.

```html
<shell :type="arcade|bingo|spain|denmark">
  <!-- Game Content Here -->
  <game></game>
</shell>
```
